scripts.dev: concurrently -n nx,admin,storybook -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --dir apps/www dev" "pnpm --dir apps/admin dev" "pnpm --dir packages/design-system dev"

scripts.ci:github: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@11.13.0 --activate && corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && corepack pnpm build-storybook && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 sh -c 'if [ -d apps/www ]; then corepack pnpm --dir apps/www build; else corepack pnpm build; fi'
